user.title: Track a recurring event
user.description: Give the thing you want to track a name. A button and a set of sensors will be created for it.

record.name: Record
record.description: Records that the tracked thing happened. Use the timestamp field to enter an occurrence you remember from the past.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When it happened. Defaults to now. A time without a timezone is read as local time.

remove_last.name: Remove last
remove_last.description: Deletes the most recently recorded occurrence. Use this to undo an accidental press.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Deletes every recorded occurrence. This cannot be undone.
